title: composition
responsibility: Validates source-declared component levels, native element names and direct runtime component dependencies.

outputs.name: compositionSchema
outputs.description: Zod strict object schema for composition metadata, validated whenever a value is parsed: `level` is required and must be one of atom, molecule, organism, layout or page, `element` is an optional trimmed, non-empty string, and `uses` is an optional array of trimmed, non-empty strings listing direct runtime component calls (type imports and navigation links are excluded). Unknown keys are rejected, and composition is independent from the responsibility category and stable unit identity.
